This guide focuses on a straightforward, infrastructure-based solution to accept Bitcoin for your ebook sales without relying on restrictive payment processors. By leveraging [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/sovereign-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-which-architecture-actually-16|COREMERCH guide to sovereign]] commerce stacks, you can ensure complete ownership and control over your sales process while eliminating high fees and transaction barriers.

For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-automated-digital-product-10. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

The fundamental issue with platforms like Gumroad and PayPal is their restrictive access in certain countries. These platforms often impose high fees, like Gumroad's 10%, which depletes your profits. With NOWPayments, you only incur a minimal 0.5% fee, significantly boosting your earnings. This infrastructure empowers you to create a self-reliant business model that bypasses traditional limitations and puts you in control of every transaction.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To successfully set up your sovereign digital commerce stack, you will need a few essential tools: a domain for your store, Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for processing Bitcoin transactions. Familiarize yourself with these tools, as they form the backbone of your infrastructure. Additionally, ensure you have your ebook files ready for delivery through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by deploying your chosen stack, either the Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack. Configure NOWPayments to accept Bitcoin and set up webhooks for automatic payment verification. Use Google Apps Script to automate the delivery of your ebooks upon successful payment. This seamless integration guarantees that your customers receive their products instantly, enhancing their purchasing experience while you maintain full ownership of your data and sales process.
Keep 99.5% of your earnings with low transaction fees from NOWPayments.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your stack is deployed and configured, it’s time to launch. Promote your ebook on social media and through your networks. Direct customers to your store, ensuring they understand the ease of using Bitcoin for payment. Monitor your first transaction closely to ensure everything functions correctly. With NOWPayments, the crypto payment confirmation will trigger your automated delivery process, allowing you to focus on scaling your business.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Scaling a sovereign digital store requires no infrastructure changes at any realistic volume level for most individual creators. Cloudflare Workers processes each webhook event independently — ten simultaneous orders are handled as ten separate processes with no queue congestion. Supabase handles hundreds of concurrent database operations on the free tier. Resend delivers 3,000 emails per month on the free tier — enough for significant daily sales volume. Cloudflare Pages serves the storefront to any number of concurrent visitors without capacity constraints. NOWPayments processes payment volume without per-transaction approval delays.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Automate product delivery to enhance customer satisfaction and streamline operations.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to expand your offerings beyond ebooks or need a comprehensive setup, check the Complete Builder Kit ($197) available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This package equips you with all necessary tools to build and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack effectively.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I accept Bitcoin for my ebook sales?
You can accept Bitcoin by integrating NOWPayments into your digital store. This service allows you to process transactions with minimal fees and ensures automatic delivery of your products.
What tools do I need to set up my ebook store?

You'll need a domain, Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for automation, and NOWPayments for processing Bitcoin transactions. These tools collectively form your sovereign commerce stack.
How can I ensure my ebook is delivered immediately after purchase?

By configuring NOWPayments to trigger webhooks upon successful payment, you can automate the delivery of your ebook files using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, ensuring instant access for your customers.
What are the fees associated with using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a low fee of 0.5% per transaction, significantly less than platforms like Gumroad that charge 10%. This keeps more of your earnings intact.
Can I scale my ebook business easily?
Yes, once your infrastructure is established, you can easily add more products. Use the Complete Builder Kit to access templates and blueprints for efficient expansion.
